No. NASA FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting ASSET-F07 (the rural property) between 2026-09-26 and 2026-10-26. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period, so the result isn't a coverage gap.

This does not prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The result also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change on the land (harvest, fire, storm, clearing), or anything outside this period.

The data are near-real-time detections, assessed as of 2026-11-12. This is the current version of the result (version 1).
